summary.name: Mouse Jiggler for Mac
summary.one_liner: A free menu-bar app for macOS that moves the cursor automatically to keep a Mac awake, with schedules, app conditions, and automatic stop controls.
use_cases: Keep a Mac awake while reading or following a dashboard
Prevent sleep during an export, transfer, or supervised task
Keep a Mac active on a set weekday schedule
Stop automatic cursor movement after a set time or duration
Keep a Mac awake only while selected apps are running or in front
summary.what_it_does: Mouse Jiggler moves the cursor automatically when there is no manual input, to keep a Mac active. It lives in the menu bar and lets you set a movement range, idle delay, and movement interval, with Natural or Silent modes. Weekday schedules set when movement starts and stops, and a deactivation time or duration can end a session. Optional conditions include app-based rules (Is Running, In Front, Isn't In Front), a battery threshold, and a Prevent Sleep While Active switch. The page also describes a keyboard shortcut for toggling and screen-lock pausing.
notable: Menu-bar app with weekday schedules and start/stop times
App conditions: Is Running, In Front, or Isn't In Front
Requires Device Control and Data Access (macOS 27) or Accessibility (macOS 13–26) permission
Keyboard activity is used to detect interaction without recording typed text, per the privacy policy as stated on the page
caveats: Some controls require the optional PRO upgrade; current prices are listed in the app
Not guaranteed to override closing a MacBook lid; lid behavior depends on the Mac and external display setup
Does not control presence status in other services such as chat apps
